verdict.comment: A high draw looks ideal for FALAISE BLANC, given his propensity for hanging right, and he can see off Manton Road.

comments.bantz: Some way behind Manton Road latest but is 9lb better off today, which gives him claims
comments.browngold: Big prices and well beaten all starts, again finishing last behind Manton Road in January
comments.falaiseblanc: Won't mind the drop from 1m and Billy Loughnane is a positive booking back from a break
comments.flamboroughhead: Needs to improve off this mark and also needs to settle better back from seven weeks off
comments.harrypalmer: Stable going well of late but he'll need to be more professional back from a layoff
comments.icanboogy: Not obviously fancied back from seven months off unless the market says otherwise
comments.lilchita: Started 125-1 for her nursery debut when last seen; can't be recommended
comments.mantonroad: 6lb penalty will make life tougher but he's fine on Tapeta and has to enter the equation
comments.sweetcicely: Has gone backwards since handicapping and is tried in first-time headgear today
comments.whatwhatwhat: Can pull hard; the hood comes off as he goes up in trip, so there are risks involved

races.raceComment: mantonroad is confidently preferred with a score of 57.8%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over bantz. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 8 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Currently 3-3 over C&D, BREWING (nap) is preferred to William Dewhirst, whose own record over C&D is none too shabby either (5-7).

comments.brewing: 3-3 over C&D, all in small fields, and he holds leading claims again upped a fair 2lb
comments.catchthepaddy: Lost his way for Kevin Ryan but has bounced back round Dundalk this winter; possibilities
comments.enolagrey: Closely matched with Brewing on C&D running in January but has to improve on latest run
comments.ladyflora: Solid comeback at a big price recently; likely have plenty of use made of her down in trip
comments.lirspeciale: Solid Southwell debut for new yard ten days ago suggests the change of scenery has helped
comments.nikovo: Is usually dropped in and will need things to fall his way in a small field down from 1m
comments.williamdewhirst: Five wins and a second from seven starts over C&D; enters calculations under a 5lb penalty

races.raceComment: brewing is marginally preferred with a score of 60.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over enolagrey. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 6/14 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Masham Moor boasts a fair record over C&D but ALICE'S IMPACT showed this trip was within range last time and is preferred.

comments.alicesimpact: Looked unlucky not to go closer still back up to 1m last time; has to go on the shortlist
comments.alyara: Should do better if the first-time hood, added to the usual cheekpieces, helps her settle
comments.aspiretoglory: More on his plate, stepping out of handicap company under a penalty, but should go well
comments.barneysbay: Almost sprung a surprise over 7f here last month but predictably didn't build on it latest
comments.fiftysent: Done better with each start since returning from an absence; is one to consider
comments.iftikhaar: Maiden who's done most racing over further; can argue he's best on Polytrack but claims
comments.mashammoor: Back to form in a race that didn't set up ideally here last time and has to be considered
comments.mrslicker: Not as good the past twice, latterly behind Aspire To Glory; others hold stronger claims
comments.onlocustpoint: Left Amy Murphy since behind Mr Slicker over C&D last time; needs a deal more
comments.ravenglass: Went close for Joe Leavy on his only previous start here and ought to fare better
comments.stoicsyd: Has pulled hard in two runs back from an absence and much will hinge on how he settles
comments.vanzant: Ran poorly behind two of these over C&D 11 days ago; is some way down the pecking order

races.raceComment: stoicsyd is marginally preferred with a score of 51.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over alyara. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: On the back of a solid reappearance effort, GOZO could well open his Flat account. Aiming High is second choice.

comments.aiminghigh: Remains 2lb below last winning mark; possibilities provided she's in top form
comments.annandale: Versatile sort whose form this year features wins over 1m2f and 1m6f; solid
comments.caelan: Weak claims on his two efforts for new yard and has stamina to prove
comments.cloudsiderock: Form of latest effort has received several boosts; open to improvement
comments.gozo: 0-11 on Flat but posted a solid effort at Wolverhampton most recently; respected
comments.percywillis: Brings respectable recent form and remains on last winning mark; in the mix
comments.sonneriepower: Latest effort took his record for current connections to 0-20; others preferred
comments.sportingsilvermine: Ex-Irish 4yo; still a maiden but looks interesting on debut for skilful James Owen

races.raceComment: percywillis is marginally preferred with a score of 50.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings over annandale. Placed in 4 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
